summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block) with the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias, added numpy and torch.nn.functional imports, exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class cases. Nothing was run or committed, per the instructions, so the tests are unverified. Choices made: the distance matrix is cast to the probabilities' dtype as well as device, and the batch-coupling and max-2 matrix acceptance cases from the spec were not covered by tests.
